name: Boon Of Revelry
description: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+) You gain the following benefits. When you cast the spell, it requires no spell components, and taking damage doesn’t break your Concentration on it.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Inspire Dance
features.description: You always have the Otto’s Irresistible Dance spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

features.name: Sing Out
features.description: While a creature that failed its saving throw against your Otto’s Irresistible Dance has the Charmed condition from that spell, it can’t cast spells with Verbal components, and it sings delightful nonsense if it can sing.
